title: Record the try of a feed; fix what it found
goal: The owner's findings are fixed (test first for a defect) or recorded as new records, and the record closes
acceptance: Each finding is fixed in a PR with a test or has its own B-/F- record
The record's Verification row names the owner's try and its date
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no Tailscale names, IPs, agent tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24: 0.5 h agent for small fixes; a larger finding gets its own record instead of growing this step.
